headlines: I make LLMs reliable enough to run real financial workflows: the rules decide, the model explains, a human approves.
I lead the technical direction of Nexus, an AI accounting platform where every figure traces back to a cited clause.
Eight years of shipping software, now spent turning stapled document bundles into balanced journal entries.
From a 70M-user wallet to fine-tuned Qwen models: software first, models where they earn their place.
profile.summary: AI Engineer with 8+ years in software engineering, focused on making LLMs reliable enough to run real financial workflows: document AI, LLM fine-tuning, evaluation and human-in-the-loop systems.
profile.bio:
I'm an AI engineer with 8+ years in software engineering, focused on making LLMs reliable enough to run real financial workflows. My master's research was in machine learning: CNN-based image classification, published in a Scopus-indexed journal.

At InterOpera I built, and now lead the technical direction of, Nexus: an AI accounting automation platform serving Korean and Indonesian enterprise clients. In 14 months I went from AI Software Engineer to Squad Lead to Tech/LLM Lead. I designed its document ingestion and classification architecture, built the accounting and asset management modules, and architected Decision Studio, the deterministic rule engine that makes the platform's output auditable.

A model that is right most of the time isn't good enough for a journal entry. So I split the system: a deterministic rule and mapping engine makes the decision, the LLM explains it, and a human-in-the-loop approval layer gates anything that reaches production. Every figure traces back to an approved policy and a cited source clause.

Before that I spent years shipping mobile apps at scale, including DANA (70M+ users), and leading mobile teams at Mediatropy and Biznet.

projects.title: InterOpera Nexus
projects.summary: AI accounting automation for Korean and Indonesian enterprises: documents in, balanced and auditable journal entries out. I built it from the first commit and now lead its technical direction.
projects.description:
Nexus reads high-volume scanned and PDF accounting documents (OCR, layout parsing, page splitting, multi-label classification of stapled bundles, field extraction) and turns them into journal entries, financial statements and reconciliations.

Decision Studio and the Policy Compiler keep the LLM out of the decision path: a deterministic rule and mapping engine decides, the model explains, and a human-in-the-loop approval layer gates production. Local Qwen models fine-tuned with LoRA/QLoRA handle extraction and classification, measured against frozen eval sets.

experiences.title: Tech / LLM Lead
experiences.summary: Technical lead across every Nexus module (Singapore, remote): architecture, model reliability, and making sure each engineer understands the product, not just the ticket.
highlights: Architected Decision Studio and the Policy Compiler: a human-in-the-loop pipeline that compiles regulatory and contractual rulebooks into approved policy items, with grounding and promotion gates before anything reaches production agents.

Reduced hallucination by taking the LLM out of the decision path: a deterministic mapping and rule engine decides, the model explains, and every output is auditable back to an approved policy and a cited clause.

Fine-tuned local open-weight LLMs (Qwen family, LoRA/QLoRA) for document extraction and classification, substantially beating the base model on production accounting documents while keeping client data in-house.
Built the evaluation and data strategy: frozen eval sets, a teach–compare–reteach loop, and typed human review events (accept / edit / reject with reason codes) as the primary training-data asset.
Set the rule that volatile facts (chart of accounts, vendor mappings, tenant rulesets) live in retrieval and context, never in model weights.

experiences.title: Squad Lead
experiences.summary: Led the Accounting & Finance squad building the core financial engine of Nexus.
highlights: Owned delivery of journal entry generation, financial statements (trial balance, P&L, balance sheet) and reconciliation for multi-tenant Korean and Indonesian clients.

Drove the document-to-journal-entry accuracy programme: frozen ground-truth snapshots, a parity harness against validated answers, per-side debit/credit line matching, and a hard Σdebit = Σcredit gate before persistence.
Designed the human-in-the-loop review workflow so every reviewer correction becomes reusable training signal.
Turned product requirements into engineering work: scoping, sequencing dependencies, design and code review, unblocking the team.

experiences.title: AI Software Engineer
experiences.summary: Founding engineer on Nexus, the AI-driven accounting automation platform.
highlights: Built the document ingestion pipeline end to end: OCR, layout parsing, page splitting and field extraction for high-volume scanned and PDF accounting documents.

Owned document classification: multi-label typing of every page in a stapled bundle (payment vouchers, official receipts, journal vouchers, invoice bills, tax invoices, bank advices), routing each to the right extractor.

Built the Accounting module (chart of accounts, GL account typing, document-to-journal-entry with balanced debit/credit lines) and the Asset Management module (fixed asset registers, depreciation schedules and their postings).
